描述_EN: fragmentary monochrome tapestry square. a thin monochrome border remains on the right-hand side. this medallion is surrounded in the corners of the square by other figures, hunters, perhaps putti, armed with a circular shield and a shot that they are preparing to throw at the hares and lions present on the four sides. the main character, a hunter (?), appears in a central medallion.
